ios.desc:
Slice And Share lets you add a border to your image to fit a desired aspect ratio. This way your photos can fit perfectly on social media, without cropping. 

If you ever wanted to share an image on a social media platform and it ended up being cropped, or if you wanted to share multiple images in a carousel post and the social media platform required them all to have a single aspect ratio, or if you simply want to add a pleasing border to your image - this app is for you.

The image is automatically centered and positioned. Works with multiple images too!

The background color can be set to black, white, or to a color from a list of dominant colors extracted from the added images.

The app supports dark mode.
